elements.quote: Fifty souls, one harbour, and every one of them with an opinion about your ship.

elements.p: The harbour is the front door: the grand pier in the middle, the fishermen's pier to the west and the cargo pier to the east, with the quay and its stalls between them.

Up from the quay is the Bazaar square with its great fountain. The Grog Barrel tavern stands east of it, the Mermaid's Rest inn to the west, and the chapel and the Governor's Residence further up the hill.
The Wavebreak Watch keeps the guardhouse and the drill yard. Above the town the Governor's Fortress holds the high ground with a dozen great guns. The Wavebreak Light burns on the eastern headland.

Past the wall lie the North Downs: the farmstead, the orchard and cider press, the shepherd's hut, and the Ridge Lookout with its telescopes. The giant chess board is on the Chess Green, just outside the gate.
The Gardens have lawns, a pond and swings for the children. There's a cattery, an aviary, a barber, a tattooist, a toymaker and a painter's studio. Townhouses line every street, and no two are alike.

elements.quote: A wreck lies broken on the south-east beach. The old hands say her captain left something behind.

elements.p: Every soul in Wavebreak has a name, a trade and a day of their own. They work, eat, drink, gamble, pray, paint, play chess and go to bed. Talk to any of them.

Chat once a day and bring gifts. Everyone has favourite things, and a gift they like counts for far more than one they don't. Strangers become Acquaintances, then Friends, Good Friends and Best Friends.
Friends wave and greet you by name, and give you 5 to 15 doubloons off in every hundred they charge.
Tobias Penn the crier walks the streets calling the news, and the gossip in the tavern is always true: who won at chess, who caught the biggest fish, whose ship is in, who was lost at sea.

elements.row: Polly Marlowe, the Parrot Keeper - today's birds
Agatha Purr - ship's cats at the Cattery
Bartholomew Snip, the Barber - a shave and a trim
Dr Elias Marrow - patches you up, for doubloons
Governor Thorne - a pardon from the Armada
Big Hal Grogan - the Grog Barrel
Martha Goodbarrel - a room at the inn

elements.quote: And Lazlo Quick, if you can find him. Only after dark, in the alley behind the warehouses.

elements.p: Eight keepers trade round the fountain: Quartermaster, Fishmonger, Barkeep, Curio Dealer, Gunsmith, Chandler, Cook and the Map Merchant. They restock every day. In the evening they go to the inn, so come early.
The town deals in DOUBLOONS. Pirate coin is pirate money, and only pirates want it.
Every seventh day a pop-up stall goes up in the plaza and Marco Venn the travelling merchant comes to town, with rare things that are different every visit.
The board outside the Watch offers three contracts a day: a hunt, a delivery or a ship to sink.
Wavebreak belongs to the Iron Armada. The Fort Garrison keeps the gates, the Night Watch walks the streets with lanterns, and the Governor's Guard stands at the Residence.
Fall foul of the Armada and the guards will throw you off the Residence grounds and out of the Fortress, and the fortress guns will open fire on you.
A sleeping guard sees nothing, so you could try your luck at night. The honest way back is a pardon from the Governor. It costs plenty if you have been very bad.

Moor in the harbour for more than a couple of minutes without a permit and the harbourmaster chains your helm. Pay at the Dues Ledger or a Berth Bollard. A paid-up ship made fast at a bollard is repaired while she waits.
